findings.title: Exact result fails required compact-storage audit
findings.description: The C9 and final C10 collection artifacts independently decode to the same 3,345,163 raw bytes (SHA256 f5071343d0ab13e4909a39077eea753bd01ab7956cde2f18b72dbaf436a2cb0d) through distinct current-tree payload paths. The actual exact-R compact audit reports duplicate-bulk. This violates unchanged duplicate-bulk storage admission and the mandatory passing final audit; eleven valid check executions do not waive it.
findings.required_action: Produce a compliant prospective storage repair at a new revision while preserving original source/result/failure bindings, rerun applicable checks, and obtain fresh SHA-bound reviews. No deletion of failed evidence or gate waiver.
